purpose: Operate and troubleshoot pve instances deployed with the OneClickVirt scripts.
notes: Read the platform precheck and installation pages before changing a host.
Use the existing host runtime and its credentials. Instance IDs and names remain the native runtime identifiers.
MCP starts read-only. Set ONECLICKVIRT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=1 on the intended host to expose start, graceful stop and restart; deletion, reinstall and arbitrary shell commands are not exposed.
PVE uses pvesh and the cluster-reported node/type; qemu and lxc guests are kept distinct. ARM64 PVE packages are community PXVIRT.
purpose_zh: 管理和排查由 OneClickVirt 脚本部署的 Proxmox VE 虚拟机与 LXC 容器。
notes_zh: 变更宿主机前，先阅读平台准备和安装页。
使用本机已有运行环境及凭据；实例名称和 ID 保持原运行环境的标识。
MCP 默认只读。在目标主机设置 ONECLICKVIRT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=1 后才提供启动、正常关机和重启；不提供删除、重装或任意 Shell 执行。
使用集群返回的节点和实例类型调用 pvesh，区分 qemu 与 lxc。ARM64 PVE 使用社区 PXVIRT 软件包。

purpose: Collect structured hardware/system information without running CPU, memory or disk benchmarks.
notes: Read probe_help from the installed binary before assuming flags are supported. MCP returns native JSON when the program provides JSON, otherwise native text.
Keep partial/network errors distinct from confirmed test outcomes. Current release assets and their actual architecture are available through release_assets.
purpose_zh: 读取结构化系统和硬件信息，不运行 CPU、内存或磁盘基准测试。
notes_zh: 先用 probe_help 核对已安装程序的实际帮助。程序支持 JSON 时返回原生 JSON，否则返回原生文本。
区分部分结果、网络失败和确定结论；通过 release_assets 查询当前真实产物及架构。

purpose: Collect a bounded VPS Fusion Monster system report, interpret results and select explicit follow-up tests.
notes: Use the maintained Go ECS binary, not the retired Shell edition or GUI executable.
The system preset disables benchmarks, media/IP checks, network speed tests, logs and public uploads. Additional tests require choosing their resource/traffic scope.
Resolve the published ECS release once; retain its exact tag and SHA-256. A cached file under a mutable output tag must still be verified.
purpose_zh: 执行有明确范围的 Go 融合怪检测，解读结果并选择后续测试。
notes_zh: 使用当前维护的 Go ECS 程序，区分已停止新功能开发的 Shell 版和 GUI 版。
system 预设关闭性能基准、流媒体、IP 质量、测速、日志和公开上传；扩展测试前明确资源与流量范围。
同一次安装只解析一次正式版本，并校验标签对应的 SHA-256。即使 output 标签不变，缓存也必须按摘要校验。

purpose: Inspect and configure 6in4 IPv6 connectivity on the intended Linux host.
notes: Use network_status for read-only IPv6 addresses and routes; it does not configure tunnels, proxy NDP or advertise new addresses.
Confirm the real routed prefix, public IPv4, tunnel peer and interface names before applying the existing scripts. Never use documentation example prefixes on a live interface.
Keep native routes, Docker/CNI tracking and existing responder services intact; do not start duplicate responders.
purpose_zh: 查看 Linux IPv6 地址和路由，并按实际网络条件配置 6in4 隧道。
notes_zh: network_status 仅查询 IPv6 地址和路由，不创建隧道、不启用 NDP 代理、不宣告地址。
执行原有脚本前核对真实路由前缀、公网 IPv4、隧道对端和接口名，不将示例地址直接配置到真实网卡。
保留现有路由、Docker/CNI 跟踪及 responder 服务，不重复启动同一代理。

Keep native routes, Docker/CNI tracking and existing responder services intact; do not start duplicate responders.

notes_zh: network_status 仅查询 IPv6 地址和路由，不创建隧道、不启用 NDP 代理、不宣告地址。

保留现有路由、Docker/CNI 跟踪及 responder 服务，不重复启动同一代理。

purpose: Find and verify current kvm_images operating-system image release assets for a compatible virtualization runtime.
notes: Resolve the requested operating-system tag with release_assets; latest is only the most recent release, not a complete catalogue of distributions.
Filter asset names using the requested OS and architecture; an empty match means unavailable, never substitute amd64 for ARM64.
Keep rootfs/LXC, Incus/LXD metadata pairs, QCOW2/KVM and ISO artifacts distinct. Review published checksum/validation metadata before importing; do not execute templates as programs.
purpose_zh: 查找并校验 kvm_images 中适用于目标虚拟化环境的系统镜像产物。
notes_zh: 用 release_assets 查询所需操作系统的实际标签；latest 仅代表最近一次发布，不代表全部发行版目录。
按系统及架构过滤真实文件名；结果为空即为不可用，不自动以 amd64 替代 ARM64。
区分 rootfs/LXC、Incus/LXD 元数据配对、QCOW2/KVM 和 ISO，导入前核对校验及验证信息，不将模板当作程序执行。

按系统及架构过滤真实文件名；结果为空即为不可用，不自动以 amd64 替代 ARM64。
区分 rootfs/LXC、Incus/LXD 元数据配对、QCOW2/KVM 和 ISO，导入前核对校验及验证信息，不将模板当作程序执行。

purpose: Find and verify current pve_kvm_images operating-system image release assets for a compatible virtualization runtime.
notes: Resolve the requested operating-system tag with release_assets; latest is only the most recent release, not a complete catalogue of distributions.
Filter asset names using the requested OS and architecture; an empty match means unavailable, never substitute amd64 for ARM64.
Keep rootfs/LXC, Incus/LXD metadata pairs, QCOW2/KVM and ISO artifacts distinct. Review published checksum/validation metadata before importing; do not execute templates as programs.
purpose_zh: 查找并校验 pve_kvm_images 中适用于目标虚拟化环境的系统镜像产物。
notes_zh: 用 release_assets 查询所需操作系统的实际标签；latest 仅代表最近一次发布，不代表全部发行版目录。
按系统及架构过滤真实文件名；结果为空即为不可用，不自动以 amd64 替代 ARM64。

purpose: Deploy and maintain Convoy using this repository's reviewed shell scripts.
notes: Read installconvoy.sh before installation and build_swap.sh before changing swap. Uninstallation changes services and data; inspect uninstallconvoy.sh and preserve required backups.
purpose_zh: 按仓库现有脚本部署和维护 Convoy 面板。
notes_zh: 安装前阅读 installconvoy.sh，更改 swap 前阅读 build_swap.sh。卸载会影响服务及数据，应核对 uninstallconvoy.sh 并保留所需备份。

purpose: Deploy Pterodactyl panel/Wings and manage the repository's node import and egg workflows.
notes: Distinguish panel installation, Wings installation and existing-node import. Read scripts/install_pterodactyl.sh, scripts/install_wings.sh or scripts/import_node.sh for the requested operation. Preserve existing database, node credentials and game data.
purpose_zh: 部署 Pterodactyl 面板和 Wings，处理节点导入及 Egg 工作流。
notes_zh: 区分面板安装、Wings 安装和导入现有节点，分别核对 scripts/install_pterodactyl.sh、scripts/install_wings.sh、scripts/import_node.sh。保留已有数据库、节点凭据和游戏数据。

purpose: Install or remove the Cockpit setup maintained in this repository.
notes: Review scripts/install.sh or scripts/uninstall.sh first. Respect the target distribution and preserve existing Cockpit configuration.
purpose_zh: 按仓库现有脚本安装或移除 Cockpit。
notes_zh: 先阅读 scripts/install.sh 或 scripts/uninstall.sh，核对发行版并保留现有配置。

purpose: Deploy the Virtualizor Docker setup and diagnose its existing Compose services.
notes: Inspect the repository's actual Compose/service definitions and installer options before choosing ports or volumes. Protect panel state and licensing configuration.
purpose_zh: 部署 Virtualizor Docker 环境并排查已有 Compose 服务。
notes_zh: 先检查实际 Compose 服务定义和安装器选项，再选择端口及数据卷。保留面板状态和授权配置。

purpose: Install and interpret the public IP-quality checker release without accessing its private implementation.
notes: Use public oneclickvirt/securityCheck release artifacts only. Do not fetch or publish the private security repository. Verify the installed binary help; network-provider failures are unknown findings, not proof of reputation.
purpose_zh: 使用公开 IP 质量检测产物，不访问其私有实现仓库。
notes_zh: 仅使用公开 oneclickvirt/securityCheck Release，不拉取或公开私有 security 源码。先核对已安装程序的帮助；上游数据库请求失败应记为未知。

purpose: Build, install and troubleshoot the Fyne ECS desktop/mobile application.
notes: Use the exact platform release assets; Android APK, macOS app, Windows EXE and Linux archive are different products. Keep VERSION and FyneApp.toml aligned when modifying builds. For headless MCP, use the ecs integration.
purpose_zh: 构建、安装和排查基于 Fyne 的融合怪桌面或移动应用。
notes_zh: 区分 Android APK、macOS app、Windows EXE 和 Linux 压缩包。修改构建时同步 VERSION 与 FyneApp.toml；无图形界面 MCP 使用 ecs 集成。

purpose: Generate and verify OneClickVirt's public image seed catalogue.
notes: Inspect auto.sh and its release filtering before changing images.txt. Preserve OS tag and architecture distinctions and retain the existing validation/filter tests.
purpose_zh: 生成和校验 OneClickVirt 公开镜像种子目录。
notes_zh: 修改 images.txt 前核对 auto.sh 及其 Release 过滤逻辑，保留系统标签和架构区分，并运行现有过滤测试。

purpose: Build the specific Dockerfile template requested from this repository.
notes: Inspect the selected image directory, Dockerfile and entrypoint. Select a concrete build context and check base-image architecture; do not build every image by default.
purpose_zh: 选择并构建仓库中实际需要的 Dockerfile 模板。
notes_zh: 检查选定目录的 Dockerfile 和入口程序，使用明确的构建上下文及基础镜像架构，不默认构建全部镜像。

purpose: Create the offline macOS ISO artifacts maintained by this repository.
notes: Read the current image-production scripts and platform requirements. Verify the exact macOS version and output checksums; ISO creation is not proof that the guest boots on every host.
purpose_zh: 按当前脚本制作离线 macOS ISO 并核对版本及校验值。
notes_zh: 核对当前制作脚本、平台要求、macOS 版本及输出校验值。ISO 制作完成不等于已验证所有宿主机都可启动该系统。

purpose: Run and maintain the virtualization installation test harness.
notes: Use action_tests/run_env_test.sh for the selected target environment. Read its environment and privilege requirements, use isolated guests and keep fixture evidence distinct from real installation/guest-boot evidence.
purpose_zh: 运行和维护虚拟化安装脚本的自动化测试环境。
notes_zh: 按目标环境使用 action_tests/run_env_test.sh，先阅读权限及环境要求，在隔离客户机测试，并区分模拟数据、真实安装和客户机启动证据。

purpose: Integrate the shared Go configuration library used by OneClickVirt benchmark modules.
notes: Read go.mod and the exported Go types before changing consumers. Preserve compatibility with current benchmark modules; this library is not an independently runnable diagnostic.
purpose_zh: 在 Go 检测模块中使用共享配置库，并保持调用兼容。
notes_zh: 先阅读 go.mod 和导出类型，保持当前检测模块的调用兼容。此库不作为独立检测程序运行。

purpose: Use the Go library that embeds dd dependencies for controlled benchmark workloads.
notes: Read exported APIs and embedded binary selection for the target OS/architecture. Keep the test path in disposable storage; never target a raw block device or production data.
purpose_zh: 在受控测试中使用内嵌 dd 依赖的 Go 库。
notes_zh: 先核对导出 API 及目标系统和架构的嵌入产物选择。只使用可丢弃的测试文件，不指向裸块设备或生产数据。

purpose: Use the Go library that embeds fio dependencies for controlled disk benchmarks.
notes: Inspect the exported configuration and embedded asset selection. Bound runtime/file size, use disposable files and preserve explicit paths.
purpose_zh: 在受控磁盘测试中使用内嵌 fio 依赖的 Go 库。
notes_zh: 核对导出配置和内嵌文件选择，限制运行时长、文件大小并保留用户指定路径。

purpose: Use the Go library that embeds mbw memory-bandwidth dependencies.
notes: Inspect exported APIs, platform support and memory allocation before running. Bound working-set size on shared hosts.
purpose_zh: 在有内存用量限制的测试中使用内嵌 mbw 的 Go 库。
notes_zh: 先检查导出接口、平台支持及内存分配，在共享主机限制工作集。

purpose: Use the Go STREAM library for bounded memory-bandwidth testing.
notes: Inspect exported APIs and platform-specific implementations before selecting a workload. Keep results tied to the actual test method, working set and concurrency.
purpose_zh: 使用 Go STREAM 库执行有明确范围的内存带宽测试。
notes_zh: 先检查导出接口和平台实现，报告结果时保留测试方法、工作集和并发数。

purpose: Deploy and troubleshoot the GitHub Release download-counter Cloudflare Worker.
notes: Inspect worker-code.js and its route parameters. Query existing public release counts; do not invent authenticated administration endpoints or deploy account-wide Cloudflare changes.
purpose_zh: 部署和排查 GitHub Release 下载数统计的 Cloudflare Worker。
notes_zh: 先检查 worker-code.js 的真实路由参数；查询已有公开 Release 下载数，不虚构管理接口或改动账户范围的 Cloudflare 设置。

purpose: Read and troubleshoot existing Cloudflare/D1 visit counters.
notes: counter_monthly reads /api/monthly and never increments the counter. ONECLICKVIRT_COUNTER_URL may set the HTTPS base URL of an existing deployment.
Counter creation uses /api/create with the existing deployment's authCode; keep that secret out of source, prompts and documentation. MCP exposes monthly statistics only.
purpose_zh: 读取并排查已有 Cloudflare/D1 访问计数器。
notes_zh: counter_monthly 只读取 /api/monthly，不增加访问计数。可用 ONECLICKVIRT_COUNTER_URL 指定已有部署的 HTTPS 地址。
新建计数器的 /api/create 使用部署现有 authCode，该凭据不得写入源码、提示词或文档。MCP 仅提供月统计查询。
